sanitization_note: This is a sanitized, committable copy of the platform_worktree_executor completion report. Raw 40-char git commit SHAs are truncated to 7-char short SHAs so the artifact passes the repo's detect-secrets pre-commit hook (Hex High Entropy false positive on full commit hashes). raw_report_not_committed_reason: detect-secrets (pre-commit, baseline .secrets.baseline) flags the raw report's full base_sha git-hash as a Hex High Entropy String (exit 1). JSON cannot carry an inline 'pragma: allowlist secret' comment, and the tracked .secrets.baseline lives outside the allowed scripts/ + ai-ledger/platform/ scope, so modifying it would fail the strict platform_diff_auditor allowlist audit. The raw report is therefore regenerated on demand; this sanitized artifact plus the ledger are the committed evidence.
